rationale: Class 2 row-level FX01 review. The filing footnote says debt par is USD unless otherwise noted Euro, and table 12 rows 6-9 show debt instruments with Euro-denominated principal amounts. Because FX01 flags missing principal_amount_usd for non-USD source par, the blank observed value is a real extraction/normalization gap for those cited rows.
